result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: the Company owns and receives a present assignment of Site deliverables, retains ownership of its Content, Marks, and customer/user data, while HDI retains pre-existing and generally applicable tools, software, and know-how and grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded or operationally necessary HDI materials. It also expressly excludes joint ownership. The addition is confined to the identified IP and data gap and does not disturb the existing control, acceptance, merchant-of-record, product-title, or trademark-use provisions. Drafting is strong, though the relationship between the broad ownership of the “Site” and HDI’s retained embedded IP could be stated somewhat more explicitly as a carve-out.
